programme.title: La Brea
programme.desc: The Swarm: James, Eve and Gavin infiltrate Lazarus to save Ty and stop Kiera. Meanwhile, Veronica races to rescue Ella from a deadly horde beneath the Clearing. (S2, ep 12)

programme.title: Animal Control
programme.desc: Baby Kangaroos and Chickens: Frank and Victoria compete to win Fiona's affections at the new kennels' fundraiser and Emily gets some bad advice from Bettany on her speech. (S3, ep 4)

programme.title: Animal Control
programme.desc: Hot Dogs and Lobsters: Trivia night turns wild for Animal Control when Frank and Emily team up to beat Shred and his girlfriend. Also, Victoria's sister visits from New Zealand. (S3, ep 5)

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Heir to the Clan: The daughter of an alpha female, hyena Spotty is a princess. But in a savagely competitive family, she must cement her status quickly or lose her rank forever. (S2, ep 6)

programme.title: Hawaii Five-0
programme.desc: Ohuna (The Secret): As well as investigating the demise of a gifted computer hacker, McGarrett takes on the tall task of reuniting his mother Doris and sister Mary. (S3, ep 7)

programme.title: Hawaii Five-0
programme.desc: Wahine'inoloa (Evil Woman): McGarrett is caught up in a game of cat and mouse with a seductive therapist and murder suspect, while Catherine reconnects with Agent Channing. (S3, ep 8)

programme.title: S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: Left of Boom: Radioactive material is stolen and SWAT races against time to stop a nuclear attack on Southern California. (S8, ep 8)

programme.title: S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: Open Season: When Hondo learns there's a $1 million bounty on his head, 20-Squad must race to uncover the enemy from Hondo's past who's intent on revenge. (S8, ep 9)

programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Norway No How: Port Wenn residents learn the truth about their Norwegian sister city deal and Martin faces his blood phobia exposure, delivers a baby and encounters his ex. (S1, ep 13)

programme.title: New: Superstore
programme.desc: Lowell Anderson: When the Cloud 9 founder's son makes a surprise visit, the employees struggle to accommodate his bold ideas. (S6, ep 13)

programme.title: New: Superstore
programme.desc: Perfect Store: Some inside information leads the Cloud 9 employees to try to make the store seem perfect for one day. (S6, ep 14)

programme.title: Rob & Romesh Vs Fashion
programme.desc: Rob and Romesh strut their stuff on the catwalk and meet male model David Gandy. Then, it's off to NYC to try and bag a gig on a real-life runway. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: A League Of Their Own:
programme.desc: ...The Rally. The Rally begins in London as Jamie, Jill and Micah race across the Channel by plane, boat and bike, before a romantic stop in Paris. (1 of 3)

programme.title: Mechanic: Resurrection
programme.desc: Master assassin Jason Statham is blackmailed into carrying out more near-impossible hits. Action sequel. (2016)

programme.title: S.W.A.T. Exiles
programme.desc: A past decision of Hondo's catches up with him, leading him to suspect someone close may be hiding what they truly know. (S1, ep 3)
